area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors
description: Maps a unit's own code to an item, a batch and a status. The till reads it when a scanned code is not a barcode. System Manager only.

fields.description: A name a person reads, for example: Unit barcodes on batches.
fields.label: Source name

fields.description: The table the shop already keeps its unit codes in, for example unit barcodes on Batch.
fields.label: Record type

fields.description: The field holding the scanned code. It must be set unique, so one code names one unit.
fields.label: Code field

fields.description: When an item barcode misses, sources are tried lowest first.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: An active line attribute that keeps the scanned code on the sale line. A unit already sold on another till is then refused before payment.
fields.label: Record the code as

fields.description: The row's field that links to the Item, or parent to use the item of the row's Batch.
fields.label: Item field

fields.description: Optional: a field linking to the Batch, or parent for the Batch the row belongs to.
fields.label: Batch field

fields.description: Optional: a field linking to the Serial No.
fields.label: Serial field

fields.description: Optional: the field saying whether the unit can be sold.
fields.label: Status field

fields.description: One per line, for example Available. Any other status shows: This unit is already sold.
fields.label: Sellable statuses

fields.description: Optional field linking to the Warehouse. Then only units in the till's store are found.
fields.label: Warehouse field

lede: A table the till's scan reads when a code is not an item, a serial or a lot.
name: Retail Scan Source
